description:
On the /fly route, the HUD heliocentric speed readout displays 'NaN km/s' for the entire transit of outer-planet missions (destinations beyond Mars: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, Ceres)

Expected: The HUD speed readout must show the spacecraft's real heliocentric orbital speed (a finite number in km/s) at every point along the transfer trajectory, for all destinations including outer planets

Acceptance criteria:
- Flying any outer-planet mission (dest=JUPITER|SATURN|URANUS|NEPTUNE|PLUTO|CERES) on /fly must not produce NaN in the HUD speed readout at any frame position along the transfer arc [code-invariant: NaN is an unrecoverable display error; the app must never show NaN in a user-facing numeric readout]
- The HUD speed readout at the departure-body (Earth) distance (~1 AU) must match the vis-viva value for a Hohmann transfer from Earth to that destination: v = sqrt(μ × (2/r - 1/a_transfer)) × AU/yr→km/s, where a_transfer = (R_EARTH_AU + dest.a) / 2 [spec: ADR-010 / AGENTS.md physics section: 'Transfer arc: Keplerian half-ellipses'; fly-physics.ts:29-33 documents the Hohmann vis-viva formula; DESTINATIONS table in lambert-grid.constants.ts:131-144 provides per-destination a values (jupiter.a=5.203, saturn.a=9.537, etc.); mission-arc.ts:29 exports A_TRANSFER = (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU)/2 as the hardcoded Mars-only case]

Domain facts:
- Vis-viva equation v = sqrt(μ × (2/r - 1/a)) is valid only for r in [a×(1-e), a×(1+e)] (within the transfer ellipse). Beyond aphelion, 2/r - 1/a < 0 → sqrt → NaN.
- DESTINATIONS table (lambert-grid.constants.ts:131-144) supplies per-destination semi-major axis `a` for all 13 destinations including outer planets and dwarf planets.
- fly/+page.svelte already imports DESTINATIONS (line 65) but does not use it for the aTransferAu computation.

Target: src/lib/orbital/fly-physics.ts — heliocentricSpeed
Do NOT change src/routes/fly/+page.svelte — it is not the owner of this symptom.
